paras: Application: 2020+ Toyota GR Supra (A90/A91) and 2018+ BMW Z4 (G29) – B58B30O1 (B58B30B), B58B30M1 (B58B30C) and B58TU engines Part Type: Port injection kit (cylinder head adapter plate and fuel rail) Part Number: 20-0753

The Radium Port Injection Kit (PIK) is an adapter that sits between the intake manifold and the cylinder head, permitting the use of port injectors for the additional fuel required by highly modified B58 engines. It does not replace the OEM direct injection system, and the adapter plate can also be used as a simple intake manifold spacer without the fuel rail by fitting 2AN ORB plugs.
hl: Port Injection Adapter: Adds port injectors without replacing OEM direct injection
Spacer Option: Plate can be run as an intake manifold spacer with 2AN ORB plugs
6063 Aluminium Fuel Rail: CNC machined, laser etched, 8AN ORB end ports
Targeted Spray: Injectors angled into the centre of the intake ports
Retains Engine Cover: Relocation hardware for the OEM vanity cover
Fuel Compatibility: All fuel types including E85
ft: Radium Engineering Port Injection Fuel Rail Kit for Toyota Supra A90 2019+/BMW Z4 G29 2018+
